# Workflow Commands

Read `../../../docs/skills/WORKFLOW-COMMANDS.md` before selecting project commands. Prefer the repository's npm scripts and the narrowest useful validation command for the changed area.

Do not run broad or destructive commands unless the task calls for them; preserve existing user changes and generated files.
